integrity: Scientific proof and accompanying symbolic finite-moment checks are provided. Priority against all historical literature and independent mathematical validation are not established.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-point microscopic windows for circular complex Gaussian self-reciprocal polynomials; no non-Gaussian universality, full global root law, convergence rates or higher correlation classification is asserted.
title: Independent even-Gaussian microscopic limits and quartic zero depletion for palindromic Kac polynomials
